answer: A hostile operator running 30 aliases therefore needs 24 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in garden, expire in falcon, and comet lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 30 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4307 identities would post 1844 proofs and burn roughly 70 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
